# tokens-bruecke

> Figma plugin + CLI that exports Figma variables and styles as DTCG 2025.10 design tokens JSON. The CLI (`npx tokens-bruecke`) either fetches variables via the Figma REST API (requires a Figma Enterprise plan) or transforms a local snapshot passed with `--input`, and writes tokens to a file or stdout.

Set up a config file: `npx tokens-bruecke init` (asks 4 questions; `init -y` writes defaults, and it never prompts when stdin is not a TTY).

Quick CLI usage:
`npx tokens-bruecke --api-key "$FIGMA_TOKEN" --file-key <FILE_KEY> --output tokens.json`
or pipe-friendly: `npx tokens-bruecke -a "$FIGMA_TOKEN" -f <FILE_KEY> --stdout --quiet`

No REST API / no Enterprise plan — transform a snapshot dumped from the Figma Plugin API:
`npx tokens-bruecke --input snapshot.json --output tokens.json` (use `--input -` to read stdin)

- [Snapshot JSON schema](schemas/tokens-snapshot.schema.json): input contract for `--input` — raw Figma Plugin API shapes for variables, collections and styles
- [Example snapshot](examples/tokens-snapshot.json): ready-to-copy `--input` file
